title: Tailscale Service (svc:) reachability
note: svc:payments has VIP 100.96.0.20 backed by api-1/api-2; the ACL lets tag:client reach it on :443 only. Tailground rewrites svc:payments:443 to the VIP before compile and probes reachability against each backend's filter. Engine-only (TestEngineCases): Tailscale Service provisioning is plan-gated and the harness allocates no VIP.
